name: B10-0051/2024 (Verts/ALE) – The severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
title: Resolution on the severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Maria Kalesnikava and all other political prisoners in Belarus, who it says are held in life-threatening conditions. It condemns their treatment and urges Belarus to provide medical care and contact with lawyers and families. It asks the European Union and its member states to make visas and residence permits easier for Belarusians fleeing for political reasons, and to help those who cannot return home to renew identity documents.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Political prisoners in Belarus and Belarusians seeking visas or documents in the EU.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and member states; they decide whether to act.
